grammar.summary: 本课学习表"告别/致敬"的完成时语境与 mark 表纪念。

points.title: 现在完成时表总账式总结
points.explanation: He has taught for forty years. 职业生涯总述：完成时收拢"40年教学生涯"对现在的影响。

examples.en: He will be retiring next week after forty years of teaching.
examples.cn: 执教四十年后，他将于下周退休。

points.title: too...to 复现与 never too...to 的反转
points.explanation: never too old to learn = 活到老学到老，too...to（太……不能）的 never 反转表肯定。

examples.en: It is never too late to mend.
